name: Kazue Tsurumi
designNotes:
Created 2026-09-30 from this regular's cast entry in canon/scenes/rest--bathhouse.json. Everything about who they are and what they want is that entry's own; only the physical description and the ancestry are new.

ANCESTRY, chosen by Claude under Ingram's 2026-09-30 goal (any ancestry is allowed): Vesk ('Vesk are a warmongering, reptilian people who conquered the eight worlds in their solar system shortly after they developed spaceflight, forming the Veskarium empire.' -- ancestry-catalogue.json): an alien ancestry: aliens are rare in Kurose and draw stares, and many refuse to wear glamour (canon/world/glamour.md, D024), which makes this one of the room's sore thumbs.

PORTRAIT: A crocodilian Vesk woman in a white sailor's cap and navy smock, brass whistle at her collar, arms folded: stern and faintly amused, and the room's biggest sore thumb.

VOICE NOTES: forced catchphrases in this regular's tics and sample lines were rewritten as habits and manner (tools/art-review/ledger.json has each before and after).

Her or his real statblock is still a placeholder in the scene file (Proposed: level 2, a working adult and former ship's boatswain, non-combat. Made with Ingram once the NPC generator exists.); not carried here.
status: drafted 2026-09-30 from the haunt's cast entry; portrait chosen the same day

facts.text: she turns the letter over. The housing office will pay well, give her a new flat with its own hot water, and pull the bathhouse down for a block of rooms.

revealTrigger.narrative: Friendly or better, and a Diplomacy check at her Will DC
